Bank data: accounts, balances, transactions and identity, for the Items an app links.

## API key

**Unverified:** nobody has checked this against Plaid's own docs yet. [Tell us](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Fix%20provider%20docs%3A%20) if something is wrong.

1. Open [dashboard.plaid.com](https://dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** Plaid needs a client\_id and a secret on every call, in the JSON body or in the PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add plaid
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  plaid: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Plaid's [API](https://plaid.com/docs/api/) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show plaid` shows the key as set.

**Rate limits:** Set per endpoint and per Item: /accounts/get allows 15 a minute per Item and 15,000 a minute per client.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Plaid).
